ModMetaData.name: Living World
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Off-map faction life: other settlements drift, flip ownership, and make news you hear through rumor, proximity, or radio — without a second storyteller dumping threat at you.
Phase 1 (chronicle + settlement morph). Faction wars, refugees, and sibling hooks come later. Personal antagonists stay in Nemesis; player goodwill stays in Deep Colony; homestead flavor stays in Homesteader.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save.
